title: The Foal Comes Home
offer: Silke's filly is big enough now, and the stable is ready. Take her home! She is nervous on the water: make room in the boat, and row gently.

steps.load_say: There, little one, stand still. Row gently, girls!

steps.say: She trots into the new stable and sniffs the hay. Your first horse! What will you call her?

fact: A horse was the most precious animal on a viking farm, worth more than a boat.
